title: 17 ideas from the element catalogue, built
blurb: A picker wheel from <select multiple>, a mixing desk from range inputs, a dialog with a drawn backdrop, a bar chart from table cells and 13 more. Each keeps the real element and says what the page had to add.
question: Can the ideas in the element catalogue be built with the real elements: a wheel of options, rotated range inputs, a dialog in the canvas, table cells as bars?
result: All 17 work. Options, list items and table cells can each be drawn on their own. A range input turned a quarter turn needs help with touch drags.
